location_address_placeholder: Start typing a street and number
location_address_hint: Type at least 3 characters. Pick a match, or press Search.
location_no_results: No matches. You can enter the place manually.
location_degraded: The address service is not answering right now. Enter the place manually or place the pin yourself.
location_limit_reached: Too many searches in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
location_precision_street: Matched to the street only. Check the pin.
location_precision_town: Matched to the town only. Place the pin on the exact spot.
location_attribution_dgu: Addresses: Croatian State Geodetic Administration (DGU), Croatian open licence, downloaded {date}.
location_pin_help: Drag the pin, or focus the map and use the arrow keys (10 m, hold Shift for 100 m).
location_pin_moved: The pin was placed by hand and will not be replaced by a new address search.
location_pin_empty: Choose an address first, or enter coordinates.
location_pin_no_webgl: The map could not start in this browser. Use the latitude and longitude fields instead.
location_town_note: Your pin is shown near your town, never at your address.
